result.title: Beyond Proposals: Region-Consistent Open-Set Object Detection
result.summary: Open-set object detection (OSOD) suffers from a fundamental limitation under dense proposal mechanisms: highly overlapping proposals associated with the same object are often assigned contradictory known/unknown predictions. Existing methods perform open-set reasoning independently for each proposal, while ignoring the shared semantics among correlated proposals, resulting in fragmented detections and unstable open-set decisions. In this paper, we reformulate OSOD as an object-centric semantic inference problem, where correlated proposals jointly support a coherent region-level semantic decision. Based on this perspective, we propose OCSI-Net, a unified framework that combines object-centric semantic consistency with geometry-aware uncertainty stabilization. Specifically, OCSI-Net aggregates correlated proposals into structured region clusters and infers region-level semantics from aggregated semantic evidence, thereby enforcing coherent open-set predictions within the same object region. Furthermore, a geometry-aware uncertainty mechanism is introduced to stabilize optimization near open-set transition boundaries. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmarks demonstrate that OCSI-Net consistently achieves state-of-the-art performance, improving the harmonic mean of known and unknown detection by an average of 6.83\% over the second-best method.

AI.brief_summary: 论文把开放集目标检测重构为以物体为中心的语义推断问题，提出 OCSI-Net：将高度重叠的候选框聚合为结构化区域簇，基于聚合证据做区域级语义判断，并引入几何感知的不确定性机制稳定开放集边界附近的优化。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「多个相互冲突的候选证据聚合为一致的区域级决策」与边界附近的不确定性稳定，可能为 LVR 中多种 latent 假设的合并、视觉证据筛选及停止判定提供可核查的类比线索，但研究场景是 2D 检测，迁移需较多核查。
